name: qa
title: Browser QA at phone + desktop width
summary: One command that opens every route of the built site in Chromium at 390px and 1440px and fails on overflow, errors, broken requests, heading/landmark/alt/name problems, with screenshots.
when: Before every PR or demo. Especially after layout work: horizontal overflow on phones is the most common bug in a fresh build.
next: npm run build && npm run qa. Open .cache/qa/*.png and actually look at them.
No Chromium? npx playwright install chromium (or set QA_CHROMIUM).
